Springboks:Chasing the sun

By: Sinethemba Nogude | Production

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
We look at the behind the scenes of of the Springbok's momentous victory which is all Captured in the documentary : Chasing the Sun

Unique Selling Point:
We will have a sneak peek at never seen footage that was taken during the Springbok's historical run during the Rugby World Cup. We will feature a lot of candid behind the scenes moments and we will look at the task of putting together such a documentary.

Summary:
From a sport defined by its past, and a country defined by its differences, comes the story of a team that chooses to believe in something more.

“Chasing the Sun” is a powerful SuperSport documentary made in collaboration with the Springboks and tells the rousing tale of their path to redemption and World Cup glory in 2019.

The five-part documentary series, to be broadcast on M-Net, will debut on Sunday, October 4 (6pm) and conclude on November 1, on the eve of the one-year anniversary.



The famous triumph remains a powerful memory, but the story behind the famous win is perhaps even more remarkable.

SuperSport was granted unprecedented access to the Springboks both in the build-up and during the tournament which helped produce incredible behind-the-scenes footage that goes to the heart of what it took to claim the Webb Ellis Cup last November.

“Chasing the Sun” is no ordinary story. It is a story about changing fortunes and changing mindsets, about pressure and hope, about recognising the power of inspiration, and learning what representation truly means.

The moving documentary charts the Boks’ rise from dejection and under-performance to the pinnacle of international rugby, so vividly demonstrated when captain Siya Kolisi lifted the trophy in Tokyo.

With unprecedented access and exclusive contributions from coaching staff, players and commentators, the documentary is the story of how a team, a nation and the world came to discover that we are all indeed stronger together. “Chasing the Sun” is infused with humour, technical insights and emotional engagement that will reveal the Springboks like never before.

Script:


Script : Chasing the Sun

- Visuals of springboks lifting trophy , celebrations in SA- 10 seconds

- Link : The entire country celebrated world cup glory in 2019,but we don’t know what it took to get there until now

- v/o A collaboration between SuperSport and the Springboks , Chasing the Sun , a five part documentary series tells the rousing tale of the Boks path to redemption ,culminating in World cup Glory on that fateful night in Tokyo, Japan.

- V/O Granted unprecedented access , the film crew followed the team for two years in the build up and during the 2019 Rugby world Cup, capturing incredible behind- the -scenes footage where viewers will get to hear the private locker-room conversations and see the quirky antics their rugby heroes got up to

V/O For Supersport CEO Gideon Khobane the idea was to bring viewers closer to their beloved Bokke

- Upsound :03:15 We went into their team camps , we went on their journey with them , when they played the rugby championship, when they won the championship, it’s a story longer than the six weeks of the world cup.// 04:20, I wanted the audience to get to know the characters , I wanted them to get to know siya , for them to get to know the coach, the coach plays a huge role
- 17:15 Upsound Rassie (Episode 2 ) Its that one try where we made a mistake , otherwise they haven’t been in the game,put yourselves in their heads, they are shitting themselves … I know you a little bit tired ,but they are also fucked.

- v/O From the darkest days …. to proud moments and ultimately reaching the pinnacle of world rugby Journalist Liam del Carme covered the Sprinboks extensively

-
Upsound 05:15:Liam Del Carme you had a team that had stayed together for nineteen weeks , you can find that friendships are forged , bonds are made and I think that is was we saw in the lead up to the final ,going into the dressing room and you see those celebrations , everything built up and culminated











Bit of breathing room
V/O But even for the toughest Springbok ,having a film crew can be a bit bewildering at first.
Upsound Frans Malherbe 05:25 Obviously it was something new having someone and the camera always filming , in training , in meeting rooms , in cloak room before a match and after , it was something new for us// and after a day or two everyone was very used to it .
Claire Mawisa question : You had a crew following you guys

- Upsound Pieter Steph 03:20 That was actually quite fun, , they actually became part of the family, if they weren’t in the meeting room we asked were they were //they knew were to draw the line , when they can film and cannot film
V/O From tough training sessions , to the bruising matches , the crew captured it all…even the more tongue in cheek moments
- Visual of Faf, Prince Harry etc
Upsound Frans Malherbe 08:09 Yeah Faf was in his underpants for two days, it was not enjoyable for the rest of us , as for him, but yeah it was awesome man.
Upsound Pieter Steph : 08:53 Frans Steyn walking up to prince harry and wanting to give him a beer was quite funny for us ,Faf’s speedo was intense
Claire Question : What can South Africans expect from this series
- 10:00 Upsound Pieter Steph du Toit It will be nice to see, that it is a full time job and the hours we put in , its actually quite tough, when they think its only glamourous
-
- -06:41 Upsound Frans Malherbe I think that the will be a lot of thinks coming out, as I said earlier I am very excited and I think that South African who watch it will really enjoy it and they will definitely get a good idea , the inside of the team, as we went on.

--- Chanting---
